# Provenance

`stb_image.h` and `stb_image_write.h` are vendored from [`nothings/stb`](https://github.com/nothings/stb)
at `2c980bb59875b0d32144a71867fbdebb2f77cd20`, 2 of its 431 files. stb publishes no releases: copying
the header is how it is consumed. It is dual-licensed MIT or public domain, in `LICENSE`.

## Local edits

None. An update is a copy of both headers from a newer commit, plus the edits listed here.
